purpose: Audit original Neotoma 15 WCVP plants x pollen/macrofossil pilot for repeated content across different taxon queries, then test official Neotoma v2 taxon-name filter vs definitely nonexistent botanical-name negative control and exact taxon-ID occurrence endpoints. Never infer fossil species occupancy without sample-level source verification.

probe.filter_pairs: Same occurrence endpoint and same time/proxy/limit; ONLY taxonname changes. Compare response SHA and occurrence IDs, including the impossible sentinel. Inspect source registry result separately; require unambiguous exact Neotoma taxon name and immutable numeric taxonid for taxonomy-specific path.
probe.request_budget: Three named occurrence queries, three taxon-lookup queries, and up to two taxonid-specific occurrence queries; do not retry timeouts indefinitely.
probe.age_issue: Neotoma ageold/ageyoung API contract may be an intercept with dataset time range; do not treat as per-sample 18–24ka confirmed chronology
probe.source_response_scope: record ID, taxon name and fossil age/site field metadata only; no ancient presence claims, no full download

expected_outputs: original pilot repeated-hash audit with exact source status
live source query-control status per case and full response SHA
precise taxon registry match only where source returns exact binomial
taxon-ID-specific API feasibility, age-field structure; source availability/timeout explicitly distinct
technical status: source filters verified, filters fail, or undecidable with reasons
science_firewall: No ancient plant occurrence or 21 ka population location is inferred from HTTP200 or top-two generic database records
Different taxa with byte-identical nonempty occurrence payloads under a taxonname filter are treated as filter integrity failure
Impossible taxon positive result under taxonname query is a negative-control failure even if 200
An exact name in the taxon table does not validate per-sample pollen species identification or calibrated fossil ages
No result-guided taxon substitutions. TTF v0.5 and chocho v0.8 host-specificity negative results stay unchanged
No genus pollen record is relabeled as a WCVP accepted binomial species
Do not compare fossils with genetic outcomes until independent sample-level chronological and taxonomic verification is complete
